definitions.event_name: An explicitly represented event, occasion, appointment or activity serving as content or an argument of the request: something scheduled, recalled, queried, reported, used as a condition or temporal anchor, or included in requested message/list content. A command merely specifying the assistant operation does not by itself supply this role. Apply request-relevant scope. Explicit calendar-entry retrieval and an unambiguous scheduling construction can represent an event without an event noun; the operation alone still cannot.
definitions.device_type: An expressed kind of physical equipment or appliance involved in the request. Hardware role must be supported by the utterance; structural objects, alert records, content and software do not automatically qualify. Apply request-relevant scope.
definitions.app_name: An identified application or software service used or explicitly referenced as the means of accessing or performing an activity. Identification may use a name or a registered service-specific lexical expression such as tweet or Google as a search verb. Assistant address, corporate identity or a generic operation alone is insufficient. Apply request-relevant scope.
definitions.business_name: An identifying name of a company, organization or commercial establishment expressed in that organizational, merchant or provider role. A product-brand modifier or software platform identity alone does not establish this role. Apply request-relevant scope.
definitions.weather_descriptor: An explicitly expressed meteorological condition, property or supported weather-protection criterion, including a question asking for a particular weather property. A generic weather request alone is insufficient. Apply request-relevant scope. Solar/lunar geometry, astronomical event timing and daylight duration alone are outside this meteorological predicate.

event_name: Calendar or event-schedule entry retrieval/removal explicitly represents its event contents even with what, anything, everything or that: what is on my calendar and remove everything on my calendar qualify. The contents are represented by the construction, not inferred from a native intent.

An elliptical scheduling construction with a represented participant/appointment relation and temporal anchor can qualify: put me in on Tuesday at ten with Al supplies scheduled interaction content. Put me in alone, a bare time, or an operation to open a calendar does not supply such evidence.

Do not turn every list or collection into an event. Grocery-list items, a calendar application itself, or calendar availability/free gaps do not alone establish an event. Generic what is on without an event-bearing referent can remain ambiguous.

Activities explicitly queried as planned or scheduled content can count without a title. Calendar and task-list words are not an automatic event label; distinguish collection content from the container and assistant operation.
device_type: Physical appliances/equipment explicitly typed as sockets, chargers, televisions, vacuum cleaners or coffee machines qualify in a hardware use. A smart/electrical/mechanized qualifier can establish equipment for an otherwise structural object; this is a compositional rule, not evidence that such examples were observed here.

Ordinary doors, windows, gates, curtains and rooms are structural objects, not devices merely because the assistant is asked to open/close them. Do not infer an actuator, smart home capability or equipment from the requested action. Airport gates and bridge names likewise do not supply equipment.

Alarm records, reminder notifications, alarm schedules and tones are not physical devices. Set an alarm for six, show my alarms and the alarm you sent express alerts only; clear lack of hardware evidence is negative, not unknown due to hypothetical implementations.

An alarm clock or clock can be physical hardware or a software clock when the utterance leaves that distinction open. Preserve genuine hardware/software ambiguity. An explicit mobile phone receiving an alarm independently establishes device presence.

Radio used only as playback/broadcast content or in a shuffle instruction does not establish hardware. A radio receiver physically described as equipment can qualify; a station or application alone cannot.
app_name: The registered lexical forms tweet/tweets/tweeted/tweeting in a social-message use identify the Twitter service in this dataset-era task contract, including drafting a tweet. Explicit bird-call use does not. This is a declared lexical convention, not inferred from gold social intent or from a model predicting platform identity.

Google used as a transitive search operation identifies the search service; look up in Google and named Google Calendar/Play likewise qualify. Hey/OK Google merely addressing the assistant does not qualify without a separate service role. Generic search, post, message, email or call alone does not identify an application.

A platform in a stock-price/company query is not thereby being used as software. A requested post or content lookup on a named platform can support software access and media-channel roles independently; no automatic company-role closure.

Keep genuinely ambiguous platform/provider/station roles unavailable where input does not settle them. Registered lexical conventions are versioned task definitions and must be revalidated for cross-dataset transfer, not treated as timeless brand facts.
business_name: A named company as the subject of stock/organization queries, merchant, complaint recipient or explicitly expressed provider qualifies. Native business annotation or external ownership relationships are not needed to supply the role.

A brand modifying a product, such as Wemo plug, Samsung phone or Apple phone, identifies a product and does not independently establish a company role. Explicitly contacting that company about the product can supply both roles.

Using a named application, a platform communication verb or a platform content channel alone does not establish business_name. A separately expressed organizational function may coexist; do not expand platform names by corporate world knowledge.

Generic company/store category without identifying name does not meet this named-organization predicate. Unclear organization versus product/provider attachment stays unavailable; a clearly isolated product modifier is negative.
weather_descriptor: Sunrise/sunset timing, solar/lunar distance or mass, moon phase and daylight duration are astronomical/temporal properties, not weather descriptors by themselves. Time/date/event predicates must be assessed independently.

Sunny/sunshine as an outdoor condition or forecast does express a meteorological property. A song title containing sunshine does not. Temperature at sunset explicitly adds a meteorological property; sunset alone does not.

Clothing/protection objects and windows are not automatically weather evidence. Sun glasses without a supported exposure/weather criterion remains ambiguous; do not settle it from native weather labels. Existing explicit weather-protection policy remains applicable.

event_ellipsis.regex: \b(on my calendar|on the calendar|on my schedule|on the schedule|scheduled|schedule it|schedule that|schedule this|coming up|have planned|have plans|anything planned|anything on|what.s on)\b

reading: Read all134 event-ellipsis,309 structural/alert,283 platform/brand,31 solar,74 brand/structure sources and13 explicit controls. Cohorts overlap. Diagnostic selection, not exhaustive semantic annotation.
design_extensions_without_observed_cohor: Explicit smart/mechanized structural equipment examples are a compositional convention, not an observed cohort.
Tweet bird-call contrast is a lexical exclusion, not an observed labeled source.
scope: Project contextual role definitions, not native entity-span gold. No new scope for unrelated background or standalone reports.
